# Marie Claire

> > Marie Claire is a women's lifestyle magazine covering fashion, beauty, celebrity news, and shopping deals with expert-verified promo codes and discount offers.

Marie Claire provides comprehensive coverage of fashion trends, beauty products, celebrity culture, and royal family news. The site features an extensive coupons section with verified discount codes for major fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands, along with editorial content about entertainment and style.

## Key Topics

- Fashion deals and discount codes
- Beauty and skincare promotions
- Student discounts (Student Beans, UNiDAYS)
- Loyalty programs and rewards
- Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales
- Free shipping offers
- Military discounts (ID.me)
- Sustainable fashion
- Designer clothing and accessories
- Celebrity and royal family news
- Referral programs
- Newsletter signup benefits
- Return policies
- Sportswear and activewear deals
